 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🦢 Pair of Swans Rose Quartz Crystal Table Clock

Symbol of Love • Harmony • Timeless Elegance

Bring romance, calm, and emotional balance into your space with the Pair of Swans Rose Quartz Crystal Table Clock by Studd Muffyn — a graceful fusion of crystal energy, artful design, and functional décor.

At the heart of this elegant table clock lies Rose Quartz, the crystal of love, compassion, and harmonious relationships. Known for activating the heart chakra, rose quartz is believed to attract love, strengthen emotional bonds, and create a soothing, peaceful environment.

The Pair of Swans, a timeless symbol of eternal love, loyalty, and togetherness, beautifully complements the energy of rose quartz. Their mirrored form represents balance, mutual respect, and deep emotional connection — making this piece perfect for couples, bedrooms, or relationship-focused spaces.

Designed with a serene lotus-filled landscape and a precise quartz clock mechanism, this piece doesn’t just tell time — it sets the emotional rhythm of your space. Ideal for bedside tables, living rooms, work desks, or as a thoughtful gift for anniversaries, weddings, or housewarmings.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What does the Pair of Swans symbolize?

A pair of swans represents eternal love, harmony, loyalty, and emotional bonding—making it ideal for couples and relationship energy.

Q2. Why is Rose Quartz used in this clock?

Rose Quartz is known as the Crystal of Love. It is believed to attract love, improve relationships, promote self-love, and create a calm, soothing environment.

Q3. Where should I place this table clock for best results?

Place it in the bedroom, living room, or south-west corner of your home to enhance love, harmony, and emotional balance as per Vastu and Feng Shui.

Q4. Is the crystal natural?

Yes, the rose quartz crystals used are natural. Variations in color, size, and texture are normal and reflect the authenticity of the crystal.

Q5. Can this be gifted?

Absolutely. It makes a meaningful gift for weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, Valentine’s Day, or as a symbol of love and togetherness.

Q6. Does the clock function require batteries?

Yes, the quartz clock mechanism runs on a standard battery.

Q7. Is this a Vastu or Feng Shui product?

Yes, it is designed to align with Vastu and Feng Shui principles for love, relationship harmony, and positive energy flow.

Q8. Will the product look exactly like the image?

The design will remain the same, but since crystals are natural, slight variations in crystal placement, size, and color may occur.
